notes: Source-only hostile audit. Two referenced statutes (usc-42-1758 pre-amendment §9(a)(2); usc-42-1776 §7(g)) were read and resolve the two claims not derivable from the bill text alone: the removed Dietary Guidelines requirement (struck clause (i) of 1758) and the "annual certification" frequency (stated in 1776(g)(2)(B)(ii)). No material errors, no direction inversions, no fabricated entities. Non-supported rows are all minor: unsourced prior-baseline framing ("only fat-free/low-fat") and Congress.gov structural metadata (sponsor, cosponsor count). featured_quotes are floor-speech CR quotes whose source (Congressional Record) is outside the provided bill/ref text, so they were not decomposed here.
